Question 4
?

Find the general solution to the differential equation dydx−y=y.

a
y=(xCex/2−1)2
b
y=±Ce2x+x+12
c
y=(Cex/2−1)2
d
y=±e2x+C2
e
y=(ex/2−2x+C)2
